$note: Three MCP servers: `attest` (stdio, published as @bpmforge/attest-mcp) exposes 77 validators + phase_gate_check + route_goal + list_experts; `attest-conductor` is the BDK agent that runs the /autopilot Ralph loop; `attest-ceo` is the Phase-1 CEO MCP server (ingest / extract / draft / approve / dispatch / director). See .cursor/skills/invoke-attest-conductor/SKILL.md for the conductor dial-out and .cursor/skills/attest-ceo/SKILL.md for the CEO.

attest-conductor.$comment: Local-dev invocation: served out of packages/attest-conductor via @cursor/bdk serve --mode single. For deployed Cursor installs, replace this stanza with { "url": "https://<your-conductor-host>/v1/mcp", "type": "http" } pointing at the deployed BDK agent (BDK deployments expose /<slug>/v1/mcp automatically). Private package: cannot be reached via `npx -y @bpmforge/attest-conductor`.

attest-ceo.$comment: Phase-1 attest CEO MCP server (ingest / extract / draft / approve / dispatch / director). Local-only private workspace package — not published to npm. Local-dev invocation: node packages/attest-ceo-mcp/dist/cli.js. Build with `npm run build --workspace @bpmforge/attest-ceo-mcp` first. For hosted installs the CEO is reached via the attest-ceo BDK agent (packages/attest-ceo); point `attest-conductor` dispatch at its /v1/mcp endpoint.
